steps.content: █/12 12:35 PM, at the MBCC cafeteria.
Little do you expect to meet Donald again in a place like this.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I'd always heard the chatter among those Sinners about MBCC's great grub, and it's no tall tale...
There's Donald, clutching a juicy roast pork knuckle in one hand and a whole jug of fresh juice in the other, his face shining with grease.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Honestly, the chef's magic here... A little buzz and who'd need a capture team, right? The Sinners outside would queue up in a heartbeat.
As he speaks, Donald flashes a thumbs-up to Kelvin and Ignis working their wonders in the nearby kitchen.
Soon after Donald polishes off that pork knuckle in no time, he shouts towards the kitchen:

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: A bowl of noodles next, I reckon. Then, surprise me with dessert, and I'll be on my merry way.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Gotta have the ice cream, it's a hit here at MBCC, right?
Once Kelvin delivers the dishes ordered by the "guest," she scoots back to the kitchen, then slyly peeks out to glance over at you.
Obviously, the other Sinners are just as curious about the bold blonde guy who shamelessly scrounges for meals from the Bureau. They huddle in groups nearby, murmuring and gesturing towards him.
And when you glance back at Donald, the table's feast is gone, devoured. There he is, slumped contentedly in his chair, leisurely picking his teeth with a satisfied grin.
How's the West District's big hero starving like this? Hope no one's been messing with you?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Ha, no way. Been all over the place, up to my neck in tasks. Eating? Barely had the time.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: You're a real pal... If you ever need a hand, just give me a shout. I can't promise I'll always come through, but you'll always have my loyalty.
Nah, don't mention it, it's just a meal.
A busy bee like you wouldn't make a special trip just to my place for a free meal, would you?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Belch... You know me too well.
Donald flicks the toothpick into the bin and gets to his feet.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Of course, I've come to you for some serious business to discuss.
What serious business?
Donald scans the surroundings, then sidles up to you, speaking in a hushed tone.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's too crowded here, let's find a quieter place to chat.
...Okay. I'll sort out a spot.
Follow me.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: No...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Is this where you Bureau folks usually talk shop?
No one ever comes here normally.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Exactly, right? Who'd be sane and bored enough to hang out in a spot like this?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Plus, I'm well aware that your MBCC interrogations of the Sinners are always recorded.
Relax, I've already disabled the cameras beforehand.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Should I be singing your praises or something?... Cheers, you've really thought of everything.
You're welcome.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Talk about getting cocky... Really, what I'm talking about isn't so hush-hush, let's not stand on ceremony...
Who had the bright idea to hole up somewhere out of sight again?
Oh, that was your call, Mr. Donald.
And remember, you're quite the "persona non grata" now. You've still got that juicy bounty from Nirvana hanging over you.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Me... well... you've got a point. But I can't shake the feeling this isn't the first time we've seen this happen.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...You know, this "serious business" actually ties back to Nirvana.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Of course, it's that blasted bounty. Nirvana's got eyes and ears everywhere, and guess who they've targeted now. I'm solo, up the creek without a paddle, so here I am, begging for your help...
Stop pulling my leg. With your smarts and network, Nirvana couldn't catch you in a million years.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I'm dead serious... Yet, you've got a point, if I'm set on laying low, they won't lay a finger on me.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: But, you know, it's kind of tricky... They've really "zeroed in" on me.
They came after you? You're saying...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: First, I need to make one thing clear to you.
Donald slightly straightens up, his expression unusually serious.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Did you catch the news about the "psych patients" cropping up in the West District for the last half-year?
You shake your head.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Makes sense you're out of the loop. You've just woken up, after all.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: In a nutshell, for the last half-year, BR-002 has been spreading Mania non-stop in the West District, impacting quite a few people.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: The good news is, these folks are faring better than the earlier victims of Mania. They're mainly dealing with intense mental burnout, but it's not life-threatening, at least not for now.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: With prompt medical care, they'll bounce back completely, and it won't mess with their lives going forward...
But the West District as it stands, we're not equipped to help them, are we?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: That's right. The West District, as things stand, isn't equipped to tackle this issue.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: The city's just starting to rebuild, and the only dependable medical center is SALVA Hospital. But, the patient count is just too high...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Right now, we've got more than two thousand serious cases on record, way more than what SALVA can cope with.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Then there's the mild cases... We can't do a mass check-up right now, but a safe guess? Several tens of thousands.
Donald's revelation sends a shiver down your spine.
This is a tough one... With these numbers, even the Bureau is overwhelmed.
But, I might be able to use my political clout to get the Eastside's big shots to chip in with donations. Then, we can set up a medical team in the name of humanitarian relief...
Watching your earnest offer to help, Donald gestures dismissively.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: What you've done for the West District is no secret to anyone. But this, this doesn't require your intervention.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: The West District is broke, sure, but once the Hypercube trade kicks off, money won't be an issue. We've got this covered.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's actually something else we could use your help with, something trickier.
What do you need me to do?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Well, it's quite the tale...
Donald takes a moment, then goes on:

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: You know how it is, there's been a flood of folks from Eastside recently. Some on business, others just showing off, and naturally, people from the West District looking for treatment for the Mania-induced disease.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: The issue cropped up right there. A few so-called "doctors" snatched up a "classic case" before they went back to Eastside...
At this juncture, there's a mix of resignation and appeal in Donald's eyes.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: The lady's name is... Margaret, she's my aunt.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I'm hoping you can help me get her back.
Listening to Donald, you piece together who Margaret is.
Right now, there's pretty much just one likely candidate behind such actions.
Nirvana...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: That's right, they're from Nirvana.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: They're actually from Banyan Fourth Hospital in Eastside, a hospital specializing in mental health.
Hmm...
They're planning to use Margaret as leverage, to draw you out, isn't that the case?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I can't see any other reason for this.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: How did they manage to single out my aunt from more than two thousand patients? They really pulled out all the stops, fooling the neighbors in the Drifter Camp and whisking her away, claiming it was for treatment.
These folks are relentless, aren't they?
But this is a bit of a tough spot.
If I go straight to the top brass and lean on them, I might just scare them off. Who knows what kind of dirty tricks they'll pull then.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I know that much. But since I've sought you out, it means I've already figured out a way.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Even though Nirvana pulls the strings at Banyan Fourth Hospital, not everybody there is their puppet.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I'm acquainted with a doc from there—turns out, he's just the right person to tackle our present troubles in the West District...
You instantly catch on to Donald's plan.
You mean, I can get close to him by offering him a chance to treat patients in the West District, and use that as a cover to sniff out news about Margaret, correct?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Haha, you always make things straightforward!
But is this plan solid?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Trust me, I know this guy. He's steered clear of Banyan Fourth's riffraff for years, always getting the cold shoulder from Nirvana's crowd.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: You can totally rely on his medical expertise and moral integrity. Choosing him is a sure bet.
Donald looks like he's got it all figured out.
Okay, I'm on it... What did you say his name was?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Das Arz. He's the chief psychiatrist at Banyan Fourth Hospital these days. You'll likely catch him during working hours with a simple appointment.
You note down this doc's details and then glance up at Donald.
Come to think of it, a shrink from Eastside Psychiatric Hospital... and one under Nirvana's thumb. How'd you even get in touch with him?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: You know me, Donald, the walking Rolodex, pals everywhere. Knowing a shrink isn't exactly a shocker, is it?
Donald muses for a second, then remarks:

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Oh, and a heads-up, the guy's not exactly Mr. Nice, tends to rub people the wrong way with his talk... Just don't mind that, he's actually alright at heart...
Right, I've got a handle on this.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Good as long as you know what you're doing...
Donald starts to speak, looking like he's got more to add, but he appears to be holding back a bit.
Out with it.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Ha, yeah... right, there's no point in mincing words with you.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Anyway, it's not like me to ask for help much, but this time... I really do need your hand in this.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I'm asking you, please.
